statement: The agent roster is 12, not 13: .opencode/agents holds 12 md + README.txt, .codex/agents 12 toml, .pi/agents 12 md, .devin/agents 12 dirs. Each manifest's '(13)' counts the source tree's README.txt; the roster checker's own filter excludes it, and the off-by-one also reached a commit message ('PASS 13/13').

Two agent upstreams exist and two scripts each call a different one canonical: .opencode/agents is the authoring source for Codex/Pi generators and the Hermes symlink, while .claude/agents is what Cursor and Devin symlink into. check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs:5-9 and agent-roster-mirror-check.cjs:24 use the word 'canonical' for opposite trees.
Observed: check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs --all reports '12 agent(s) checked - all mirrors in sync - OK' with exit 0, so the OpenCode-Claude pairs are in sync under the gate's own contract today.

The agent mirror gate compares EXACT normalized token sets, not order or semantics; a live instance shows the blind spot: deep-research.md differs in body (37091 vs 37109 bytes) with one copy saying 'append idea_observed' and the other 'record idea_observed through the gateway', yet both token sets are 1188 tokens and identical after path normalization, so the gate passes. Token-set equality is not semantic equality.
evidence: shell node -e using the gate's own extractAgentBody/compareBodyTokens -> matches true, 1188 vs 1188 tokens

statement: Both executions of the mirror gate are change-scoped and skip when no agent file changed: pre-commit builds STAGED_AGENTS from git diff --cached for .opencode|.claude/agents only, and the PR workflow collects PR-range changed files only, exiting 0 when none changed.

Pi is the only uncovered generated agent tree: sync-agents-pi.cjs --check runs in neither the pre-commit MIRROR_CHECKS list nor the CI mirror-parity step, while Codex's equivalent is wired in both. Nothing would notice a Pi agent falling behind .opencode/agents.

Cursor, Devin and Hermes agent trees are symlinks (links into .claude/agents and .opencode/agents), so content drift is impossible and the only failure mode is a broken or replaced link, which agent-roster-mirror-check.cjs already resolves and catches.
Codex agent generation is a one-way lossy derivation: sandbox_mode, model and model_reasoning_effort cannot round-trip back to .opencode/agents.
